title: The Sales Type column is off by default and first in the column list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location, as a user who has never changed the columns of Sales By Representative since the release.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the report's columns.
  2. Open the column selector.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • There is no Sales Type column.

Step 2:

  • "Sales Type" is first in the list.
  • It is off.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R20: “The Sales Type column is offered in the report's column selector, first in its list.”
  • S5-R21: “The Sales Type column is off by default on screen, for every user.”
